info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v2-spec
info.description: The Adopted Pets Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of pets that have been adopted through the pet adoption platform. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about each adopted pet, including their breeds, ages, and adoption dates. It serves various stakeholders, such as animal welfare organizations, potential adopters, and researchers interested in adoption trends. With this endpoint, users can easily query and display the list of adopted pets, supporting efforts in promoting adoption and responsible pet ownership.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch a comprehensive list of pets that have been adopted. Users can leverage this data to understand adoption trends and integrate it into various applications that involve pet adoptions.

requestBody.description: This request body contains criteria for retrieving a list of adopted pets. It allows clients to specify filters such as adoption date, pet type, and owner information to narrow down the results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of adopted pets.
